description:
`initialize` params. `token` is the per-client token (0.2) and is optional on the wire only so that a missing one
gets [`code::TOKEN_REFUSED`] and not a params error. `client` names the program, for the daemon's log.

defaults.description:
Start with defaults: this connection reads only the Default layer, the built-in packs and the built-in views,
and its writes are refused. Other connections are unchanged. Absent means a normal connection.

title: OwnerInitializeParams
